title: mapania cuspidata

The health benefits of Mapania cuspidata include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which have been traditionally used to treat various ailments such as fever, skin infections, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Mapania cuspidata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which exhibit therapeutic actions including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
